en.io: Input: workload volume, latency, quality targets, team, budget, use-case sector/geography, affected decisions, and GPU/API assumptions. Output: three-year TCO comparison, risk tier and control list, breakeven sensitivity, and AI-team roadmap.
en.boundary: Strategic only; it does not implement RAG, agents, evaluations, or deployment. Pricing and regulatory statements are time-sensitive assumptions, and automated classifications cannot replace jurisdiction-specific legal analysis or empirical model evaluation.
dependencies: Python for model_buildvsbuy_calculator.py, ai_risk_classifier.py, and ai_cost_economics.py
Current model pricing and GPU-cost inputs
Qualified AI regulatory counsel for binding classifications

Estimate API-to-self-hosted breakeven and plan AI roles.
